reasoning_content: Now verify the dev server start works. Let me run the start task briefly and curl it.

action.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && (MISE_ENV=staging mise run start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 25; echo "--- log ---"; tail -15 /tmp/start.log; echo "--- curl ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5173/ ; curl -s http://localhost:5173/ | head -5
